entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: These huge doors are obviously[n]suspicious. I wonder what's through[n]here.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There're slots to stick in something like[n]a keycard... Whoa, there's five of them!

entries.speaker: Chairman-esque Voice
entries.en: ...Four hundred seventy-five people in[n]favor, zero against.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I hear something.

entries.speaker: Chairman-esque Voice
entries.en: Since there is no one against the plan,[n]this bill will be unanimously passed as[n]drafted.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Passed? What's goin' on? Was that[n]Shido's voice?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If this truly is the Representatives[n]Chamber as written, beyond here[n]must be the main assembly hall.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...The what now?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's that large conference room that's[n]usually seen on the news.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ohhh, that thing. Gotcha. ...So, what're[n]they doin' inside?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Most likely a meaningless vote... one in[n]which whatever Shido proposes will always[n]go unopposed.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So he's doing whatever he wants by[n]keeping only his supporters in there.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What do we do to get in, though?[n]Should we find these keycards?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Maybe we need some kind of[n]qualification, one that vows to[n]be his follower or swear loyalty.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So basically, we need to prove that we're[n]on his side.
We'll have to pretend.
We can't do that.
I don't know...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You sure move on quick...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not up for it either. Still, we have to[n]do this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's just go about this rationally. It's so[n]we can proceed forward.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But what's this qualification thing about?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Why don't we ask the guests on this ship?
Great idea.
That's dangerous.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That thought never crossed my mind.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Asking around doesn't sound like a bad[n]idea.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The guests here are the cognitive versions[n]of them in Shido's mind. They'll know[n]any secrets he shared.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: True. You have a point.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That said, the ruler here is that evil Shido.[n]It wouldn't surprise me if they did turn[n]hostile.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right... Yeah, wouldn't they attack us?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We should prepare for the worst, of[n]course, but I think we'll at least be able[n]to talk to them.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This ship is most likely an ark loaded[n]with those that Shido believes are worth[n]keeping alive.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It'd explain the luxury cruise ship. I doubt[n]idiots who can't even hold a conversation[n]would be here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We can at least gather information.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It helps that everyone's wearing masks.[n]We'll blend in even with our attire.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He must believe that no one shows their[n]true face to anyone else... just like him.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well then, let's split up and ask around.
